purpose: Binary or tri-state selection control with bindable checked and indeterminate state for forms and lists.
useWhen: Selecting zero or more independent options from a list.
Representing a parent state that aggregates child selections via indeterminate.

avoidWhen.reason: Flipping a single setting on or off with immediate effect — use toggle instead.
Picking exactly one option from a small fixed set — use RadioGroup or segmented-control instead.
